claim: CDH1 loss in ILC activates YAP nuclear accumulation via dual mechanism: (1) LATS deactivation (CDH1/p190A RhoGAP complex disrupted, PMID 32641858); (2) PI3K-AKT-YAP crosstalk amplification (PMID 32816106). YAP-TEAD inhibition (verteporfin, IAG933) should show ILC-specific efficacy greater than IDC. Alpelisib + verteporfin combination may show synergy in CDH1-loss CDK4/6i-resistant ILC.
gap: CDH1→LATS→YAP not directly demonstrated in ILC breast cancer; verteporfin + alpelisib combination not tested in ILC
